description: This file implements core file system utilities and classes such as File, Directory, and Partition within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It includes methods for file info loading, path normalization, directory creation, existence checks, and partition info retrieval, with platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods for loading file info, normalization, and access control.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory with methods for creation, existence check, and path management.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Provides methods for partition information retrieval and path normalization.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a file path, resolving '.' and '..' segments, platform-specific path separators, and double slashes.

methods.name: LoadFileInfo
methods.description: Loads file attributes, size, and timestamps from the filesystem, platform-specific.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Returns ownership information for a user.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Returns ownership information for a group.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Retrieves permission bits for the file.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates the directory at the specified path.

methods.name: CreatePath
methods.description: Recursively creates directories along the specified path.

methods.name: RemoveRepeatedPathSeparator
methods.description: Removes consecutive path separators from a path string.

methods.name: ReadPartitionName
methods.description: Reads the device name of a partition from system-specific sources.

methods.name: LoadPartitionInfo
methods.description: Loads partition size, free space, and device name information.
